candidate.answerReason: The median makes BD=DC=4, so each side of the equilateral triangle is 8 and its perimeter is 24.

methods.label: Recover the side from its midpoint
methods.explanation: \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), so \(BC=2BD=8\). The perimeter is \(3\times8=24\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 8 definition of a median, midpoint segment arithmetic, and equal sides of an equilateral triangle.
